worldcombat.skill.psybeam.summary: Fire a phantom ray that homes in on its target: the purple light turns to run the target down, dealing special damage and possibly leaving it confused; while confused, each action it starts may be fumbled. With Echo the ray travels on, hitting up to two targets.
worldcombat.skill.psybeam.use.0: Mid-range pinpoint that curves around cover
worldcombat.skill.psybeam.use.1: Punish targets that dodge by strafing
worldcombat.skill.psybeam.use.2: Use Echo to pierce through two targets
worldcombat.skill.psybeam.description.1: On a hit, %1$s chance to leave the target confused for %2$s; while confused, each action it starts has %3$s chance to be broken.
worldcombat.skill.psybeam.description.2: The ray reaches %1$s blocks at %2$s blocks/tick, turns %3$s degrees per tick toward its target and has a %4$s block hit radius - slow turners let strafing targets escape.
worldcombat.skill.psybeam.echo.on: Echo: after the first hit the ray travels on to a second target, turns harder and is both likelier and longer to confuse, at the cost of a lighter hit, slightly less speed and range, a thinner hit radius, and a longer windup and cooldown.
worldcombat.skill.psybeam.echo.off: Single: a faster, heavier ray that hits only one target and does not pierce.
worldcombat.skill.psybeam.timing: Range %1$s blocks, windup %2$s, recover %3$s, costs %4$s PP, cooldown %5$s.
worldcombat.skill.psybeam.growth.0: From level %1$s the ray power rises to %2$s.
worldcombat.skill.psybeam.growth.1: From level %1$s the ray power rises to %2$s and the confuse chance to %3$s.
